text:
Asha: quick pass request — draft of the product launch post below. Need legal + eng signoff before we lock hero claim and CTAs. Posting the copy snippet here so it's easy to review.

Asha: [lead] Today we're launching Redwood Inference: a unified runtime that delivers predictable LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Our customers see up to 4x lower per-token cost in typical production workloads.*

Asha: CTA: Read the full post / Register for the technical webinar (link placeholder).

Evan: nice flow. can we surface the benchmark context briefly? e.g. typical seq len, batching config, and what 'production workloads' means.

Marco: :eyes: copy reads strong. headline suggestion: "Predictable LLM inference — anywhere you run it" (keeps hero short). also will need a 1200x600 hero for the blog.

Leah: flag on the "4x lower per-token cost" line — that's a comparative claim. legal needs the comparator, test window, and methodology. can we change to "up to 4x" and include a footnote/appendix with test details?

Jared: we can justify "up to 4x" based on our internal end-to-end tests vs baseline open checkpoint on cloud GPU under default batching. prefer "up to" + link to benchmark appendix.

LegalBot: automated check: the phrase "4x lower" triggers claim review. please attach benchmark doc or switch to qualified phrasing. Suggested replacement: "up to 4x lower per-token cost in our benchmarked scenarios".

Asha: ok switching to "up to 4x" — I'll add a short appendix that lists: model family, hardware, sequence length distribution, batching config, and delta calculations.

Asha: webinar plan: want a 45-min tech deep-dive (30 demo + 15 q&a). who can own speaker/ops? target week of Apr 14.

Evan: I'll own the webinar demo + deck. will include a dedicated slide with methodology and a link to the benchmark appendix. target Apr 14 11:00 PT.

Marco: design notes: landing needs two CTAs stacked on mobile (primary = "Read the post", secondary = "Register for webinar"). I'll have hero + mobile CTA comp by Apr 7.

Leah: legal asks that any slide or blog paragraph that references the benchmark include a short method blurb and link to the full methodology doc. if we use customer examples, redact PII and get customer signoff.

Asha: inserting the UTM/publish plan here for ops:```
utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=launch_inference_apr2026
hubspot_flow_id=12345
publish_window=2026-04-09T09:00:00-07:00
hero_cta_primary=Read the post
hero_cta_secondary=Register for webinar
```

OpsBot: publish checklist reminder: ensure assets in /assets/blog/launch-inference, meta + OG image set, and HubSpot flow id 12345 wired. publish window noted: 2026-04-09 09:00 PT.

Asha: thanks — Leah, can you do a quick legal pass by EOD tomorrow? Marco, pls confirm hero assets by Apr 7. Evan, please attach benchmark appendix draft by Apr 5 so we can link it.

Leah: :eyes: I'll do a pass tomorrow morning and flag anything that needs stronger substantiation.

Evan: will upload benchmark appendix (CSV + short methodology) by Apr 5. cc @Jared for any technical clarifications.

Marco: confirmed — hero comps done Apr 7, will drop in the assets folder and ping here.

Asha: perfect. once legal OKs I'll move this into the final draft and lock the publish window. :rocket:

Evan: :thumbsup:

Leah: :white_check_mark: 

Asha: putting this into the draft doc now, will ping when updated.
